title: Home Oxygen Therapy Fee Schedule — Monthly Equipment Payments by System Class
content:
# Home Oxygen Therapy Fee Schedule — Monthly Equipment Payments

This schedule lists, for every system class of Home Oxygen Therapy, the billing code of the stationary equipment, the billing code of the portable add-on, the fee-schedule monthly equipment payment for the stationary system and the fee-schedule monthly add-on for portable equipment.

## Schedule

| System class | Stationary equipment code | Portable add-on code | Stationary monthly fee (USD per month) | Portable add-on monthly fee (USD per month) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Stationary Concentrator Oxygen (E1390) | E1390 | none | 172.61 | 0.00 |
| Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) | E1390 | E0431 | 172.61 | 28.43 |
| Concentrator with Home Fill System (E1390 + K0738) | E1390 | K0738 | 172.61 | 28.43 |
| Concentrator with Portable Oxygen Concentrator (E1390 + E1392) | E1390 | E1392 | 172.61 | 28.43 |
| Liquid Oxygen System (E0439 + E0434) | E0439 | E0434 | 172.61 | 28.43 |
| High-Flow Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) | E1390 | E0431 | 172.61 | 28.43 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The stationary monthly fee is the fee-schedule monthly equipment payment for the stationary system, with gas or liquid contents included during the payment period.
2. The portable add-on monthly fee is the fee-schedule monthly add-on for portable equipment; it is 0.00 for a class that carries no portable equipment, and that class's portable add-on code reads "none".
3. The stationary equipment code is the code of the stationary unit: E1390 for an oxygen concentrator and E0439 for the liquid oxygen reservoir of the Liquid Oxygen System (E0439 + E0434).

## Reading the schedule

**Which classes carry a portable add-on?** Every class except Stationary Concentrator Oxygen (E1390), whose add-on is 0.00 and whose add-on code is none.

**Does the stationary fee differ between concentrator and liquid classes?** No. The stationary monthly fee is 172.61 for all six classes; the classes differ in their stationary code (E1390 or E0439) and in their portable add-on code (none, E0431, K0738, E1392 or E0434).

**Do Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) and High-Flow Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) share codes?** Yes: both carry stationary code E1390 and portable add-on code E0431, and both list a stationary fee of 172.61 and an add-on of 28.43.
